definitions.gloss: fully immersed in one's hobbies; indulging in hobbies
definitions.explanation: The state of devoting oneself entirely to one's hobbies or leisure interests, often with a positive connotation of enjoying well-deserved free time.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{趣味三昧|しゅみざんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to live a life fully immersed in my hobbies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{趣味三昧|しゅみざんまい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent the consecutive holidays fully indulging in my hobbies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{趣味三昧|しゅみざんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つながり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恋|こい}しく→恋しい：03055_koishii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Since quitting work, every day is devoted to hobbies, but sometimes I miss the connection with society.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ (hobby) and ⟦{三昧|ざんまい}→三昧：05931_zanmai⟧ (deep absorption, indulgence). The suffix ⟦{三昧|ざんまい}→三昧：05931_zanmai⟧ originally comes from Buddhist terminology (Sanskrit: samādhi) meaning deep meditative concentration, but in modern usage it means indulging fully in something.

- {趣味三昧|しゅみざんまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: days filled with hobbies
- {趣味三昧|しゅみざんまい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time indulging in hobbies

USAGE:
Generally positive — implies enjoying well-earned leisure. Often associated with retirement or vacation time.
